scope: Candidate 3D models (link only, nothing downloaded) for TekPractice devices and rooms. Device ids = knowledge-base/equipment/*.json; room ids = taxonomy installations-rooms sub_types.
licence_policy: Ship only CC0 or CC BY (BY = attribution logged in ASSET_MANIFEST.json + assets-source/CREDITS.md, format: « Title » par Author (URL) — Creative Commons Attribution). CC BY-SA = caution (share-alike). NonCommercial, NoDerivs, Editorial, Sketchfab Standard / Free Standard, store royalty-free, GrabCAD and manufacturer files without stated terms = reference only, never shipped (suitable_for_tekpractice "no"). Licence of the file never clears the trademark: branded replicas must be genericized (logos/text removed, trade dress altered) before commercial release, per tekpractice-sim/CLAUDE.md "Equivalents visuels generiques uniquement". Every model still needs the rig pass (glb, real dimensions, port_<id> empties, single PBR material, Draco+KTX2, 800-4000 tris for devices).
already_in_asset_manifest_not_relisted: ev-re20 (currently Shure SM7B mesh by Marshal - mismatch)
